name: Jesimiel
title: Simeonite clan leader
summary: Jesimiel was a leader among the tribe of Simeon, mentioned as one of the prominent heads of his family. He lived during the period when the Simeonites expanded their territory and settled in new areas. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Simeon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Simeon
keyEvents.description: Jesimiel is listed among the prominent leaders of the tribe of Simeon in the genealogies of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Clan Leaders of the Simeonites
keyEvents.description: Jesimiel is mentioned alongside other named leaders who were heads of their families among the Simeonites.

keyEvents.title: Expansion of Simeonite Territory
keyEvents.description: In the time of King Hezekiah, Simeonite leaders, including the clan of Jesimiel, went out to seek pasture and settled in the area of Gedor.

keyEvents.title: Conquest of the Hamathites' camp
keyEvents.description: The Simeonite clan leaders and their people found fertile and spacious land where the Hamathites had previously lived; they destroyed the inhabitants and settled there.

keyEvents.title: Growth in the families of the tribe of Simeon
keyEvents.description: The named leaders, including Jesimiel, belonged to clans that experienced significant population growth during the period of the divided kingdom.
